sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Two boss phases split by a gliding intermission at 50%, with an 11-minute enrage that pushes her damage +200% — a real DPS check on top of the mechanics.

sections.heading: Defiance bar & Bloodstone Fragments
bullets: Her defiance bar opens at 90% health and resets every 60 seconds — break it fast, since it otherwise gives her 80% reduced incoming damage and speeds up <mark>Bloodstone Fragment</mark> spawns.

Fragments spawn every 10 seconds around the arena — they damage players and stack <mark>Derangement</mark>, but if Xera herself stands in one, she deals double damage and her conditions convert to boons. Destroy fragments deliberately to create safe space; DPS should focus the two shards nearest their marked position.

sections.heading: Derangement (chaos stacks)
bullets: Builds from environmental damage — 90 stacks causes a 5-second Fear, and 99 stacks is an instant kill. Players with Forsaken Magic mastery can destroy shards to cleanse stacks, but good positioning to avoid stacking in the first place matters more.

sections.heading: Intervention
bullets: At 75% (phase 1) and 35%/15%/10% (phase 2), phantasms channel an insta-kill blast. One random player gets the <mark>Intervention</mark> skill — wait until the phantasms channel back, then pop the barrier to shield the squad rather than using it immediately.

sections.heading: Adds & platform intermission
bullets: Regular adds spawn throughout both phases — they can be stunned and cleaved fast; pull skills help stack them under the boss.

At 50% health, the squad glides clockwise through Ley Lines, destroying bloodstone shards on each platform. Exploding orange circles spawn everywhere (damage + Derangement) — keep pace, since lagging risks platforms wrapping in damaging ribbons.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 11:00 — Xera deals +200% damage past this point.
